scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend && rm -rf dist && cp -r frontend/dist ./dist
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build --workspace=frontend && rm -rf dist && cp -r frontend/dist ./dist
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=frontend && npm run lint --workspace=backend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=frontend && npm run test --workspace=backend
scripts.check:backend: npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run benchmark --workspace=backend && npm run check:boundary
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace=frontend && npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run check:boundary
